goal: Make multiple concurrent projects understandable at a glance by showing each project's purpose, current state, current/next goal, recent achievements, roadmap and next biggest wins without returning to dashboard information overload.
constraints: Keep all genuinely concurrent projects visible.
Do not invent roadmap facts when repository sources are missing.
Do not expose private project metadata.
done_when: Every visible project explains purpose and current state.
Recent achievements are visible and celebrated.
Roadmap details are available from repository-owned evidence.
No arbitrary top-three project cap remains.
CI builds the enriched snapshot and protects the project-story IA.
uncertainties: Repository roadmap quality is uneven; cards must explicitly surface missing roadmap evidence instead of guessing.
next_step: Run syntax, UI contract, harness, GitHub adapter and real Pages snapshot build before merge.
